autolinking.//: Expo autolinking searches the project's node_modules AND every ancestor's. Without this, a build run from inside the monorepo would discover packages/web's native modules (expo-blur, expo-video, expo-document-picker, react-native-svg, ...) in the repo-root node_modules and link them into this app -- pinning both packages to one Expo SDK, and failing the native build outright when their expo-modules-core majors differ. Confining the search to this package is what lets web and shell move independently.
